author: Matthew Alton
text: John was great to work with. We had a clogged bathroom drain. John was able to come out and had the clog fixed within 2 hours of me calling him up. Quality work at a fair and transparent price.

author: Tanner Lemperle
text: John is very professional and I have worked with him several times before. Makes sure our stuff is working properly and will come out as soon as possible if we have a problem. If you need someone that is respectful, knowledgeable, and won't price gouge you for his services, John with J&S would be my go to call!

author: Greenhill Riverdale
text: John was awesome!  It took him just a few minutes to find our plumbing leak and let my team know what part is needed and what to do to fix it after having one unit shower leak into the unit below for days, and us trying to replace parts and figure it out, and we could not.  His fix was the right one, and he saved us from having to tear out a shower surround.  The price was quite good for his diagnostic time.

author: Julie Gudmundsen
text: We had a clogged drain.  John was very knowledgeable and pointed out several problems with the angle of the installation under 2 sinks.  He spent a lot of time making sure the clog was resolved and tested the drainage several times afterward to make sure everything was flowing smoothly.  Very thorough.  Highly recommend his service.

author: erica terry
text: John was amazing and extremely helpful. He  showed up on time, fixed the problem quickly, and was super friendly and professional. The price was fair and there were no surprises. I’ll definitely be calling him again in the future.  Highly recommend!
